# Arthur Birck

> Personal website of Arthur Birck, an electrical engineering student at DTU (Technical University of Denmark) and rower in Copenhagen. He is building Riggr, a GPS rowing computer. A full portfolio is coming soon.

## Links

- [Website](https://arthurbirck.dk/): Personal landing page
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arthur-birck/): Professional profile
- [GitHub](https://github.com/arthurbirck): Code and projects
- [Riggr](https://riggr.dk/): The rowing computer he is building
